description: Evolve sales territory assignment algorithms to optimize coverage, workload balance, and geographic compactness.

problem.goal: Assign 25 sales accounts to 4 reps, maximizing coverage, balance, and territory compactness

fitness_components.balance: 1 - coefficient of variation of rep revenues (weight: 0.3)

target.notes: Near-optimal with better revenue balance (0.90+ balance score)

optimization_strategies.name: revenue_weighted_clustering
optimization_strategies.description: Weight account positions by revenue when computing centroids
optimization_strategies.hint: High-value accounts should anchor territory centers

optimization_strategies.name: swap_optimization
optimization_strategies.description: After initial assignment, swap accounts between reps to improve balance
optimization_strategies.hint: Greedy swaps that reduce revenue variance while maintaining compactness

optimization_strategies.name: simulated_annealing
optimization_strategies.description: Use SA to escape local optima in territory configurations
optimization_strategies.hint: Temperature schedule for accepting worse swaps early, then refining

optimization_strategies.name: constrained_voronoi
optimization_strategies.description: Use Voronoi diagrams with capacity constraints
optimization_strategies.hint: Generate Voronoi cells then redistribute accounts to balance revenue

optimization_strategies.name: genetic_crossover
optimization_strategies.description: Combine good partial assignments from different solutions
optimization_strategies.hint: Preserve high-performing rep assignments while recombining others

constraints: Must implement assign_territories(accounts: list[dict], num_reps: int) -> dict[int, list[int]]
Each account can be assigned to at most one rep
All accounts should be assigned for maximum coverage score
Pure Python only - no external optimization libraries (scipy.optimize, cvxpy, etc.)
Must complete within 10 seconds for 25 accounts
